title: ENG Camera Operator
description: About Us The WIN Television Network is Australia’s largest commercial television network, committed to providing first-class entertainment and news services to around eight million viewers across Australia. The WIN Network is a diverse media and entertainment group with television as the core business, and other business interests in radio, film and television production, telecommunications and specialist engineering. About The Role We are currently seeking a passionate ENG Camera Operator/Editor to join our team. Reporting to the National News Director, you will be responsible for filming and editing high-quality stories for news and updates. Working in a regional newsroom offers a unique and rewarding opportunity to cover a diverse range of stories. From community events and sport to politics and environmental issues, you’ll have the chance to capture the stories that matter and make an impact within the local community. This is a full-time position, working Monday to Friday and based at our Darwin office. About You To be successful in this role, you will have: Demonstrated skills in camera operation and video editing Experience filming interviews, sporting events and community activities A high level of accuracy and excellent attention to detail Strong time management skills and the ability to work effectively to deadlines The ability to work productively within a team and contribute positively to workplace relationships The confidence to contribute ideas and demonstrate initiative and flexibility A positive work ethic, with a willingness to learn new systems and processes A high level of creativity and the ability to recognise and visually capture a compelling news story An unrestricted driver’s licence, which is essential for the role What We Can Offer You At the WIN Network, we value our employees by offering a vast and varied array of benefits. When you join our organisation, you can expect: Employee health and wellbeing program (EAP) for employees and their families Access to LIFT session, an engaging digital fitness platform offering live and on-demand workouts Discounts on shopping, tech, gym memberships, hotels and holiday destinations available through our EAP. Novated Leasing and Salary Packaging Options. Enjoy 16 weeks of employer-funded paid parental leave for primary carers (3 weeks for secondary carers), plus superannuation contributions paid on top of your employer-funded parental leave. Please note, all applications must include a Cover Letter , Resume and Demo Reel . If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you! For further information about the role, or for a confidential discussion, please do not hesitate to reach out to our People and Culture team at recruit@wincorp.com.au. The WIN Network reserves the right to commence and/or conclude the recruitment process of this position, prior to the closing date of this advertisement. All staff employed by the WIN Network must hold valid Australian working rights. WIN Network is an equal opportunity employer.
